name: David Michael Oddo
tagline: Top rated Medical Malpractice attorney in New York, New York
education: Touro College Jacob D. Fuchsberg Law Center
about: A partner and senior trial attorney at Oddo & Babat, P.C., based in New York City, New York, David Michael Oddo focuses his practice on complex and high-stakes litigation in the areas of medical malpractice, products liability, wrongful death, civil rights, pharmaceuticals, personal injury, and white-collar crime. With decades of legal experience, he is known for his comprehensive understanding of both civil and criminal law, providing strategic and effective representation tailored to each client’s unique circumstances.

Mr. Oddo approaches every case with a meticulous and results-oriented mindset, combining in-depth legal analysis with strong advocacy skills. He is committed to pursuing justice in personal injury, civil rights, and wrongful death claims. He is regarded as one of the top medical malpractice/personal injury trial attorneys in New York State, earning his reputation for results, diligence, and professionalism within the legal community.

Mr. Oddo earned his Bachelor of Arts degree from the State University of New York at Cortland in 1986. He then earned his Juris Doctor from the Touro College Jacob D. Fuchsberg Law Center in 1989, where he developed a strong foundation in legal research. He honed his trial skills as an assistant district attorney and brought those talents to the civil courts, winning record-setting verdicts for his clients.

Admitted to practice in New York in 1990 and Connecticut in 1989, Mr. Oddo is also licensed to appear before the U.S. District Court for the Southern and Eastern Districts of New York and the Supreme Court of the United States.

Mr. Oddo maintains active involvement in numerous professional organizations, including the New York State Trial Lawyers Association, where he is a Past President, and currently serves on the board of directors. He is a member of the American Bar Association, the American Association for Justice, and the New York County Lawyers' Association. Additionally, he is a fellow of the American Bar Foundation.
